_note: max_obs_age_s 0.06: joint_states publish at 30 Hz sim-time (JointStatePub default), so a 50 Hz policy sees states up to ~40 ms old even when the simulator is paced properly. The simulator must run with target_fps >= 60 (scripts/sim2sim_resources.json); at its 10 FPS default, five physics steps run back-to-back per frame and states arrive in 100 ms bursts (measured 2026-09-16: p95 gap 100 ms -> 41 ms at 60 FPS).
